preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= R <= 10**3 and 2 <= C <= 10**3 and 2 <= X <= min(R, C) for R, C, X in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, R, C, and X are between 2 and 1000 inclusive, and X is less than or equal to the minimum of R and C.

preconditions.expression: all(all(-10**9 <= A[i][j] <= 10**9 for j in range(C)) for R, C, X, A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: All elements of matrix A in each test case are between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(-10**9 <= B[i][j] <= 10**9 for j in range(C)) for R, C, X, A, B in test_cases)
preconditions.description: All elements of matrix B in each test case are between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(R for R, C, X, A, B in test_cases) <= 10**3
preconditions.description: The sum of R over all test cases does not exceed 1000.

preconditions.expression: sum(C for R, C, X, A, B in test_cases) <= 10**3
preconditions.description: The sum of C over all test cases does not exceed 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] in ['Yes', 'No'] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((result[i] == 'Yes') == (sum(A[i]) % X == sum(B[i]) % X) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Yes' if and only if the sum of elements of A and B modulo X are equal.
